title: Cancer Therapy Mechanisms and Evidence: A Cross-Literature Synthesis
description: Open-source cancer research consolidating the cancer-therapy literature into a single evidence-led synthesis: a CENSUS of the indexed cancer literature -- 5,187,265 articles, being 4,403,994 carrying MeSH indexing and 783,271 recovered by text match, with 10,509,470 typed entity relations -- measured with expert-assigned MeSH descriptors and NLM publication types rather than the project's own retrieval, so every prevalence claim is made over articles the project did not select. Paired with multi-scale computational simulations used to validate or disprove specific mechanistic claims (ferroptosis biochemistry, immune coupling, stromal shielding, drug penetration, and tumor-microenvironment effects). Ferroptosis, photodynamic and sonodynamic therapy are among the mechanisms tested, not the focus. A 4,830-article full-text corpus, retrieved by keyword query, is retained ONLY as a method-comparison arm: holding descriptor scope constant across it and the census is what separates a labelling effect from a selection effect, and it is not the basis of any reported figure. Content classes and rights: (1) Code -- Python pipeline, Rust simulation engine, tests: MIT licensed. (2) Manuscript and analysis -- authored by the depositor, released under the repo MIT license. (3) Census metadata -- PMIDs, MeSH descriptors, publication types and typed relations; factual metadata is not copyrightable. (4) Abstracts -- non-copyrightable factual summaries (Feist v. Rural, 1991). Excluded from this deposit: full-text articles, reference textbooks (Git LFS, CC BY 4.0 but 1.6 GB), and news articles (fair use, not a redistributable license). See PROVENANCE.yaml for full asset licensing details.
